name: Действительно впечатляющий титул
alt: Впечатляющий титул представлен медалью с короной, пером и уточкой вместо герба.
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: one square original illustration for a humorous fantasy card game, readable at 384 by 384 pixels. Funny expressive caricature, bold clean ink outlines, loose watercolor and gouache on warm parchment, colorful accents. One obvious visual joke, simple chunky shapes, minimal background, centered large subject with comfortable margins. Modest detail, no intricate scenery. No text, letters, digits, logos, watermark, border or card frame. Clear anatomy, no extra limbs. Subject: An absurdly ornate golden medal hangs from a ridiculously wide purple ceremonial ribbon, decorated with a crown, a feather and a tiny rubber duck crest. The proud trophy is almost bigger than its little display stand. All surfaces blank, no lettering.
